acreline.title: Acreline
acreline.blurb: WordPress theme for farms, land, and historic homes — listings, agents, and showing requests.
acreline.summary: Acreline is a WordPress real estate theme for farms, land, and historic homes. Searchable listings, map views, agents, and showing requests — Customizer identity, eight color styles, no page builder required.
acreline.challenge: Land and farm buyers need acreage, township, and lot-type filters plus a map. Generic luxury realtor skins bury parcels and force IDX chrome offices do not need.
acreline.approach: Listings, agents, and bookings ship in the theme. Identity and colors live in the Customizer. Filters are query args. Payment-estimate and showing requests stay vanilla JS — no Elementor, no ACF Pro required.
acreline.result: A ThemeForest-ready pack: install the zip, brand it under Customize → Identity, seed demo inventory, and sell land the way rural buyers search for it.
acreline.audience: Land offices, farm brokerages, and agents selling acreage or historic homes who cannot use a suburban MLS skin. Also agencies that need a rural real estate base they can white-label.
acreline.architecture: Sage 11 + Blade + Tailwind v4 + Vite. Listings, agents, and bookings as post types (optional Acreline Core plugin so they survive a theme switch). Native SEO tags yield to Yoast / Rank Math. Classic metaboxes on purpose.
acreline.handoff: You own the theme zip, child theme, and Core plugin. Brokers edit parcels, photos, and copy in wp-admin. HTML docs ship in the pack. Hire me to import your inventory or brand the Customizer.
benefits: Ship a land-and-farm listing site without starting from a luxury realtor kit
Filters that match acreage, parcel context, and historic homes
Showing requests and agents built into the theme flow
Customizer identity + eight color styles — brand it in minutes
Child theme + Acreline Core so listings survive a theme switch
100% GPL-compatible theme code — sell or customize freely
deliverables: Type, price, acreage, and area filters
faq: What do I get when I buy Acreline?
The marketplace pack: acreline.zip (upload in Appearance → Themes), optional child theme, Acreline Core plugin, and HTML documentation. Instant download after checkout.
Is Acreline a live MLS or IDX theme?
No. It is a concept office with sample inventory. Listings are a custom post type you edit in WordPress. Wire a real feed later if you need one — the UI does not depend on IDX chrome.
Can I use it commercially / is it GPL?
Yes. Theme code is GPLv2 or later. Sage / Acorn remain MIT (GPL-compatible). You can customize, resell services on top, or white-label for a client.
Do I need Elementor or ACF?
No. Fields and identity live in Customizer + metaboxes. Do not add a page builder “to make it work.”
Can you install or customize it for my office?
Yes. Buy the pack for self-serve, or Get help and I brand it, import listings, and hand off wp-admin editing.

acreline.brand_tagline: Rural inventory, not another luxury brokerage skin.

tocflow.title: TOCflow
tocflow.blurb: Free WordPress TOC block — accessible, SEO-friendly outline from your headings. Zero config.
tocflow.summary: TOCflow is a lightweight WordPress plugin that builds an accessible, SEO-friendly table of contents from your post headings. Free download for publishers who want a clean TOC without heavy JavaScript.
tocflow.challenge: Long posts need a jump list. Most TOC plugins ship a block library, client-only rendering, or settings you never touch — and the outline misses the first HTML response search engines and screen readers need.
tocflow.approach: One Gutenberg block (plus a shortcode). The outline is server-rendered. Anchors match heading ids. Collapse, sticky, and scroll-spy stay small and optional.
tocflow.result: Insert the block, publish, done. Free on this site and GitHub — a top-of-funnel plugin that shows how I ship focused WordPress tools.
tocflow.audience: Bloggers, docs sites, agencies, and developers who want a TOC without a bloated block pack. Also a free lead-in to hiring me for custom blocks or theme work.
tocflow.architecture: PHP block render callback, small editor script, optional ItemList JSON-LD. No React runtime on the front end for the list itself.
tocflow.handoff: Download the zip, activate, insert Table of Contents. Settings live under Settings → TOCflow. Source on GitHub if you want to fork it.
benefits: Zero config — insert the block; the outline builds itself
Server-rendered HTML for SEO and screen readers
Accurate anchors with aria-current while you read
Numbered or bulleted lists, five style presets
faq: Yes. $0 checkout captures your email for update notices if you want them, or download from GitHub Releases. No freemium lock.
Does it work with classic editor posts?
Yes — use the [tocflow] shortcode. Heading anchors still inject on the front end.
The list is in the first HTML response. Front-end JS is optional for sticky/scroll-spy and respects prefers-reduced-motion.
Can you customize it for my theme?
Yes. Get help for sticky-header offsets, style presets that match your brand, or a private fork.
tocflow.brand_tagline: One block. An accessible outline from your headings.
